newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil slips, spreads steady to easier.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil slips, spreads steady to easier.

text.p: European gas oil differentials were steady to slightly easier in thin trade on Monday with outright values showing a small decline, traders said.
Front month August IPE gas oil futures were 25 cents off at 1235 GMT at $163.25 a tonne. September was $1 lower at $164.50.

Activity was muted on both barge and cargo markets as dealers awaited news on the resumption of Iraqi crude exports. Iraq has submitted a new aid distribution plan for approval to U.N. headquarters in New York.
Baghdad has made the completion of a new aid distribution plan a condition for resuming crude exports.
Heating oil was available in Rotterdam at August IPE flat to 50 cents. There was very little physical demand, with swaps rather than physical trade making up the bulk of activity.
Low sulphur diesel barges were offered slightly easier at August IPE +$4.25 cif Flushing and $4.75 cif Rotterdam.
Discussion was desultory on the cargo market. Good supply from Ventspils ahead of maintenance were keeping Russian heating oil differentials under pressure at Screen flat to $1.
